sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the two interpretations of "woman conceives first, bears a male" are explained: initially, the work of Knesses Yisrael and the drawing down from above are separate, leading to a revelation of the inner aspect of Israel's service and the power of Atzmus, while the second interpretation holds that the birth of the male is from the woman's seed itself, drawing down light beyond relation to worlds, even to Atzmus.

translations.translation: And based on this, we can explain the order of the two interpretations of "a woman who conceives first gives birth to a male,"
that initially
(before the "inner dimension" of the service of Israel was revealed),
the service of Knesses Yisrael and the drawing down from above are two separate things,
and consequently, the drawing down that comes through her is from the light that pertains to the worlds
(for the arousal from below reaches there),

and the advantage in the service of Israel then is that the service is the cause that the arousal from above drawn down through her will be from the innerness of the light — the first interpretation that the woman's seed is the cause for the dominance of the man's seed
(the upper one prevails),
and through this the inner dimension of the service of Israel is revealed,
the power of Atzmus within it
(from the aspect that Israel and the Holy One, blessed be He, are entirely one),
and all the drawings down are through the service itself
(and not that the service is only a cause for the drawing down)
— the second interpretation that the birth of the male is from the woman's seed,
and the superiority of the drawing down from above
(the birth of the male)
is
(not only the drawing down of the innerness of the light that pertains to the worlds,
but also)
the drawing down of the light that is beyond relation to worlds,
and even to the drawing down of Atzmus.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This is connected to the second of Nissan, the first Shabbat of creation in thought, and the yahrtzeit of the Rebbe Rashab and the inauguration of his son the Rebbe Rayatz, as the purpose of creation is revealed through the study and dissemination of the inner dimension of Torah, preparing for the coming of Moshiach.

translations.translation: And this can be connected to the second day of Nissan,
for according to the opinion
that the world was created in Nissan,
that is, the creation of man was on Rosh Chodesh Nissan and the creation of the world was on the 25th of Adar,
the first Shabbat day was on the second of Nissan.
And according to the known
mediation between the two opinions regarding the time of creation,
that the actual creation was in Tishrei
(the 25th of Elul)
and the thought to create the world was in Nissan
(the 25th of Adar),
it can be said,
that in the actual creation which was in Tishrei, the revelation of "He desires kindness" is also included,
and regarding this, that in Nissan was the thought to create, it can be said that this thought is like the thought of "in whom He took counsel,"
the intention and purpose of creation that was not drawn into revelation in the creation.
And on the Shabbat day,
the 2nd of Nissan,
the perfection of the thought was accomplished.
And this can also be connected to the fact that the 2nd of Nissan is the yahrtzeit of the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory,
and the day on which my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe, was crowned
(his only son of the one whose yahrtzeit it is)
with the crown of leadership,
for the intention and purpose of creation is that there should be in the world the revelation of the Ein Sof that is beyond relation to worlds
(as above),
and this revelation is
(primarily)
through the study and dissemination of the inner dimension of Torah.
For the inner dimension of Torah in its own essence is beyond revelation
(the hidden aspect of Torah),
and through the study of the inner dimension of Torah with understanding and comprehension,
and especially through its dissemination outward
(even to the utmost outside),
they draw down the light that is beyond relation to worlds,
and even to the essence of the light that is beyond revelation,
so that it will be revealed in the world.
And this is the connection of the 2nd of Nissan,
the first Shabbat of the work of creation in thought
(in which was the perfection of the thought)
to the one whose yahrtzeit it is and to his only son who filled his place,
for through the discourses of the one whose yahrtzeit it is, who is the Rambam of the teachings of Chassidus
(matters that are explained until they are arranged in the mouth of everyone),
and in particular,
through the founding of Tomchei Temimim,
a new stage in the dissemination of the wellsprings began,
and after this,
through my revered father-in-law, the Rebbe,
the dissemination was carried out with even greater strength and vigor.
And this
(the dissemination of the wellsprings outward)
is the preparation and vessel for "the king Moshiach will come"
(for then the intention
of a dwelling place in the lower realms will be completed),
speedily in the near future.
